title: Dark energy: cosmological constant or dynamical field
bottleneck: Cosmic acceleration is consistent with a pure cosmological constant, but also with dynamical quintessence fields, modified gravity, or observational systematics, and current data cannot decisively distinguish them. The equation-of-state parameter w sits near minus one with errors too large to reveal evolution.
why_it_blocks: The fate of the universe, Big Freeze versus Big Rip versus something stranger, hinges on what dark energy is; without distinguishing the options, cosmology cannot predict its own future.
current_state: DESI's baryon acoustic oscillation measurements hint at evolving dark energy at modest significance, but the signal is contested and a cosmological constant remains consistent with the data. If DESI's hint of evolving dark energy holds up, it would rule out a pure cosmological constant and demand new fundamental physics.
